sched_import.import_tip: Read an exported schedule back: rows by Id, columns by header; counts first, then one undo step
sched_import.no_id_col: No "Id" column: export the schedule first, edit that book, then import it
sched_import.ignored_cols: Columns not in this schedule, not read: {list}
sched_import.no_changes: No changes: the book matches the model
sched_import.wrong_sheet: No sheet "{sheet}" in this book: import a book exported from this schedule
sched_import.why_error: formula error, fix or clear the cell; the value is kept
sched_import.why_uncalc: formula without a result: recalculate and save the book; the value is kept
sched_import.why_formula: formula result, not an edit: type the value instead
sched_import.n_error: Formula errors and uncalculated formulas, not read: {n}
sched_import.resaved: The workbook was saved again after the first preview: this preview shows the new content
sched_import.resaved_reading: The workbook was saved again: nothing applied, reading it anew for a new preview
